Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“What the Seraphim did to the wicked was sing them clean. Try not to be wicked around one.”

Sephirotic Scion (Seraphic). Order: burning. Fire in your hands is not metaphor.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Unburning. You resist sephirotic damage.
  • Coal-Song. You know a minor Manifestation of radiant fire — see your signature feat for the dice pool and scaling.
  • Signature. You gain Cleansing Breath at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.title: Cleansing Breath
advancement.hint: Gain the Sephirotic Scion (Seraphic) signature feat: Cleansing Breath.
